name: Exec Cluster E18: Long-Only Directional Wiring
description: Tests: long-only wiring (no short_entry), hold_long with exit via SL/TP only
source:
# =============================================================================
# EXEC CLUSTER E18: Long-Only Directional Wiring
# Tests: E18 — omit short_entry for long-only strategy
# =============================================================================

src = study_assets()
close = src.c

# === SIGNAL: RSI oversold buy ===
rsi_val = rsi(close, 14)
entry = rsi_val < 30

# === EXECUTION ===
# E18: Long-only — only wire long_entry, NO short_entry
# E01: Use hold_long to keep position for minimum 10 bars
long_and_short_zone(hold_long=10)(long_entry=entry)

# Fixed percent sizing
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=25)

# Exits only — no opposing signal exit
atr_val = atr(src.h, src.l, src.c, 14)
stop_loss(unit=StopUnit.price)(distance=atr_val * 2)
take_profit(unit=StopUnit.percent)(distance=8)
